╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║     YT DOWNLOADER - DOWNLOAD & INSTALLATION GUIDE      ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

DOWNLOAD OPTIONS:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. SINGLE INSTALLER FILE (Recommended)
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   File: START-YTDownloader.bat (or INSTALL-AND-RUN.bat)
   Size: ~2 KB
   How: Just download and double-click!
   
   Location: h:\ytdownloader\dist\
   Files:
   - START-YTDownloader.bat
   - INSTALL-AND-RUN.bat
   - README.txt
   - QUICKSTART.txt


2. COMPLETE PACKAGE (With Source Code)
   ────────────────────────────────────
   Create a ZIP file:
   - dist/START-YTDownloader.bat
   - dist/README.txt
   - dist/QUICKSTART.txt
   - package.json
   - next.config.ts
   - tsconfig.json
   - src/ folder
   - public/ folder


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

INSTALLATION STEPS:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Step 1: DOWNLOAD
├─ Download START-YTDownloader.bat from dist folder
└─ Or download the complete ZIP package

Step 2: EXTRACT (if ZIP)
├─ Right-click ZIP file
├─ Select "Extract All"
└─ Choose destination folder

Step 3: RUN
├─ Double-click START-YTDownloader.bat
├─ Or double-click INSTALL-AND-RUN.bat
└─ Wait for browser to open (5-30 seconds first time)

Step 4: ENJOY
├─ Application opens at http://localhost:3000
├─ Start downloading videos!
└─ Download folder: Windows Downloads

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT YOU GET:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✓ YouTube video downloader
✓ Multiple format support
✓ Video/Audio extraction
✓ Easy-to-use web interface
✓ Local installation (no server needed)
✓ Offline-capable after first run

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Minimum:
✓ Windows 7 or later
✓ 2 GB RAM
✓ 500 MB disk space
✓ Internet connection (for first-time setup)

Recommended:
✓ Windows 10/11
✓ 4 GB+ RAM
✓ 1 GB+ free disk space
✓ High-speed internet

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FIRST RUN:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Script checks for Node.js (installs if needed)
2. Downloads dependencies (~5-10 minutes)
3. Builds application (~2-3 minutes)
4. Opens http://localhost:3000 in your browser
5. Application is ready to use!

Total time: 10-20 minutes (first run only)
Future runs: 30-60 seconds

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TROUBLESHOOTING:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Problem: "Node.js not found"
Solution: Run the script again and select "Yes" to install

Problem: "Port 3000 in use"
Solution: Restart your computer or close other Node.js apps

Problem: "npm command not found"
Solution: Restart Windows or run cmd.exe as administrator

Problem: Application won't start
Solution: Delete node_modules and .next folders, run again

Problem: Browser won't open
Solution: Manually open http://localhost:3000

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FILE LOCATIONS:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Downloaded Videos: C:\Users\[YourName]\Downloads\
Application Folder: Wherever you extract the files
Logs: Console window (stays open while app runs)

FEATURES:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✓ Download from YouTube
✓ Extract audio only (MP3)
✓ Multiple quality options
✓ Batch downloading
✓ Resume downloads
✓ Video preview
✓ Format conversion

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GETTING STARTED:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Download: START-YTDownloader.bat
2. Save to: Desktop or Documents
3. Double-click: Run installer
4. Wait: For browser to open
5. Paste: YouTube link in the app
6. Download: Click download button

That's it!
